steps.domain_action: Initialize the raw input stream as the void state before any semantic processing.
Project the input stream forward into the token embedding space.
Compose the embedding with the positional encoding to establish temporal context.
Split the enriched representation into multiple parallel attention heads.
Evaluate the affirmative arm where attention scores affirm token relevance.
Evaluate the negative arm where the causal mask rejects future token access.
Hold the contradictory states of ambiguous semantic interpretation and strict causal ordering simultaneously.
Rejoin the parallel attention heads into a unified tensor, resolving conflicts to a B-state.
Chain the attention output with the residual connection to preserve the original input.
Project the residual output forward into the feed-forward network.
Split the feed-forward input into expert sub-networks for specialized processing.
Evaluate the affirmative arm where expert networks affirm specific feature transformations.
Evaluate the negative arm where gating mechanisms reject irrelevant expert paths.
Maintain the dialetheic state where multiple expert interpretations coexist without collapse.
Rejoin the expert outputs into a single representation, fusing conflicting transformations.
Compose the feed-forward output with the residual connection from the attention block.
Project the block output forward through the output projection layer.
Fix the key-value pairs into the KV cache as a permanent record of the current context.
Initiate the backpropagation gradient descent to update weights based on loss.
Chain the gradient flow backward through the network layers.
Maintain the self-modeling identity where the system recognizes its own weight updates.
Hold the contradictory states of weight stability and dynamic adaptation simultaneously.
Anchor the final state within the dialetheic boundary, ensuring the winding number remains non-trivial.
